rationale_and_guidelines: SOH is explicitly defined in source code as (QDischarge / initial_capacity)*100. Within any single battery, SOH/QDischarge is an exact constant (std=0.0). Using QDischarge trivializes SOH prediction into a linear scaling multiplier (~92.8), bypassing internal degradation modeling. Furthermore, discharge capacity is unavailable during fast-charge screening.

RUL = max_cycle - cycle. Per-battery Pearson correlation with RUL is exactly -1.0000. If evaluated under random row splits, models memorize the battery EOL intercept and predict RUL trivially. Cycle is ALLOWED ONLY under strict Battery-Grouped splitting where the model cannot memorize unseen battery lifespans.
